messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: inference-west2 service degraded — high token-latency and increased 5xxs, paging #eng-oncall

sara-oncall: on pager. seeing a cluster of nodes flip to NotReady in west2 (us-west2-a). telemetry shows kubelet restarts + container crashes on runtime pods.

devin-sre: confirmed. k8s events: several kubelet RestartCount increased. node conditions: NotReady -> KubeletStopped. Pod status: CrashLoopBackOff for redwood-runtime containers on 4 nodes.

sara-oncall: impact: ~12% of infer traffic from west2 is erroring / timing out. eve-support, any customers flagged?

eve-support: a handful of enterprise customers reported increased latencies and a couple timed-out requests in the last 3 mins. CS is ready to communicate if this hits 20% error rate.

maria-platform: quick note — routing policy should prefer warm nodes in other zones; auto-evac fallback exists but autoscaler hasn't provisioned new warm instances yet.

tom-ml: on the ML side, if nodes go OOM or CUDA errors, we have smaller quantized variants (q4x) that can run on CPU fallback. prep those as fallback models? that avoids customer 5xxs but increases latency.

devin-sre: good plan. immediate steps: 1) mark the flaky nodes unschedulable (cordon), 2) drain workload to healthy nodes with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data, 3) add routing annotation to steer traffic away from west2, 4) spin up replacement nodes or move capacity to other regions.

sara-oncall: doing cordon+drain on node infer-node-eq2-vm-03 now.

devin-sre: paste logs from node (grep for cuda / oom):
```
[2026-03-17T21:05:12Z] runtime: panic: out of memory allocating kv cache
[2026-03-17T21:05:14Z] nvml: driver lost, GPU reset
[2026-03-17T21:05:14Z] kubelet: container runtime reaped pid 4452, exitCode=1
```

maria-platform: I'm flipping routing annotation: service/redwood-infer -> add annotation routing.redwood.com/avoid-zone=us-west2 for 2 mins to drain traffic. applying now.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: routing annotation patched by maria-platform — rollout id 8fa3.

tom-ml: while we drain, let's enable model-fallback at the router for west2: fallback-model=redwood-small-q4x for any request hitting health-check fail. This will preserve correctness for customers who don't need low-latency.

sara-oncall: enabling fallback in router config now. command: `rdwctl route update inference --zone us-west2 --fallback-model redwood-small-q4x`

infra-oncall: I'll start node replacement and check AMI/kernel. suspect recent kernel patch + CUDA driver mismatch. pulling driver logs and instance system logs.

devin-sre: add kubelet log tail to the thread please: `journalctl -u kubelet -n 200`

sara-oncall: added snippet: `kubelet: E0320 21:04:56 eviction_manager.go:345] eviction signal received: memory.available<func` — we see reactive OOM evictions then kubelet crash.

infra-oncall: found two nodes on the same kernel patch level with NV driver 525.85 which is known to trigger GPU resets after 1000-2000 hours on this image. I'm rolling a revert to driver 520.61 for new nodes. starting replacement ASG cycle.

maria-platform: autoscaler scaling activity: currently 0 pending. I'm temporarily allowing burst capacity from Dedicated pool (team-approved emergency) to handle routing while we replace nodes — bumping capacity +15%.

eve-support: notifying affected customers: short note that we detected a regional degradation and are rerouting traffic; ETA 20-30m.

tom-ml: quick mitigation summary for product: 1) temporarily fall back to q4x for west2 2) route traffic away from drained nodes 3) replenish nodes with driver rollback 4) once stable, revert fallback and routing.

devin-sre: health checks improved after routing change. observed 200s for previous 5xxs drop to <2%. error rate trending down.

sara-oncall: live monitor shows 3 nodes still flapping. draining two more now.

infra-oncall: replacement nodes come up with driver 520.61 and kubelet v1.27.4, attaching to cluster. will test with canary workloads before routing back.

deploy-bot: canary workloads passed on replacement nodes — latency and nvml stats normal for 15m.

maria-platform: removing routing.redwood.com/avoid-zone=us-west2 annotation in 5m and gradually shifting traffic back with 10% increments. will keep fallback enabled until 50% traffic shift complete.

eve-support: updated customers: now reporting improved response times.

devin-sre: post-incident action items: - audit AMI driver versions across regions - add k8s alert for rapid kubelet restart counts - add preflight for driver-kernel mismatch on image builds - verify autoscaler reserve buffer for hot-warm pools

sara-oncall: adding a short incident report in #incidents. tagging infra and platform for follow-ups. thanks all. :thumbsup:
